family's manifest defines them; see [README.md](../README.md#verification) and the family docs.

## Table 2: streams

One row per stream. Rates are over the coded stream; the 1-s p99 is the 99th percentile of a
one-second sliding window. CPU figures come from an instrumented mGBA run over the whole stream
("busy" = everything except the player's idle wait; p99 and max are over frame windows), cross-checked
against a GBATEK cycle model in unicorn. Late frames are frames shown after their scheduled time.
Cart ids are the short ids of [verify/carts.csv](../verify/carts.csv).

## Table 3: families compared

Qualitative rows summarise the families' `features.md`; the numeric rows are computed from the
streams above (episodes and movies only, not logos, for the rate and load ranges).

| | VX++ | VXGB | FVMV | Hydrogen | ADS | AM3 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| developer / engine | Actimagine; Actimagine loader, 64 MiB Matrix mapper | same as VX++ | Actimagine codec and player; ARM SDT image | Majesco Hydrogen library ("crt table" engine) | Majesco ADS engine (SFCD archive + .mmstr); also 2 Hydrogen-engine carts | Actimagine Loader 1.0.620 on the adapter; player on the card |
| codec type | hybrid block codec: prediction + 4x4 transform | same as VX++ | block-based pixel-domain codec (no transform) | vector quantisation, 1 byte per block | vector quantisation, 1 byte per block | unknown (needs a card dump) |
| colour | YUV 4:2:0, shift-only YUV->BGR555, 2x2 dither | same | RGB555 directly (no YUV) | YCbCr codebook -> RGB555 per segment, 4x4 ordered dither, brightness gain | same as Hydrogen | ? |
| blocks | 16x16 MBs, binary split tree to 2x2, 12 modes | same | 8x8 cells, recursive halving to 1x2/2x1, 7 leaf modes | 4x4, 4x3, 3x3 or 4x2 per segment | same as Hydrogen | ? |
| intra / inter | per block; MC from 3 references, integer-pel | same | per block; MV copy from 1 reference, integer-pel, +-8 | every frame a full raster of codebook indices; no MC | same as Hydrogen | ? |
| transform / residual | H.264 4x4 integer IDCT | same | none (colour offset and fills) | none | none | ? |
| entropy coding | Exp-Golomb + MPEG-4 intra TCOEF VLC | Exp-Golomb + H.264 CAVLC tables, own syntax, nC grids | fixed prefix codes, raw colours and MV bytes | DEFLATE variant (codebook + index blobs per segment) | LZMA (lc0 lp0 pb2, 128 KiB dictionary) | ? |
| rate control | constant QP (per-frame QP syntax) | one QP per stream (header) | no quantiser; encoder mode choice | codebook per segment; no quantiser | codebook per segment; no quantiser | ? |
| keyframes / seek | seek table every ~200 frames | same | seek points every 3-225 frames, linked records | segment = keyframe = seek point (median 32 frames) | segment = keyframe; chapters point at segments | ? |
